title: What gives away where you live?
instruction: You are about to post a photo. Mark everything a stranger could use to tell where you live.
debrief: It isn’t only what you write that gives your address away. The background of a photo, the metadata and a location tag are enough.

items.text: The name on the doorbell in the background
items.why: A name and a house: that is almost an address.

items.text: The GPS location in the photo’s metadata
items.why: The exact coordinates of where the photo was taken.

items.text: The school logo on your hoodie
items.why: The school narrows it down to a few streets.

items.text: A photo of the sky with nothing else in it
items.why: Clouds give nothing away. Unless there are coordinates in the metadata.

items.text: The number of the tram outside the window
items.why: The route and the stop show the neighbourhood.
A drawing doesn’t show a place.

items.text: A “home” location tag on the post
items.why: You gave that one away yourself.
